name: Customer-path probe loss + independent BGP flap on the DIA egress: confirmed across two planes
comment: The trusted customer-path active probe corroborates the control-plane BGP flap on the same DIA seam. A probe alone never confirms; here the independent control_plane witness (a different observer, different modality) lifts it to confirmed. This is the multi-plane sibling of dia-egress-latency (probe only) and bgp-peer-flap (control-plane only) — it wins when BOTH planes corroborate.
